observations: Photo 0 shows a black game console held sideways in a hand; body shape, disc slot, and vented top are consistent with an original Xbox One.
Photo 1 shows the same console with a black Xbox-style wireless controller placed on top of it.
No power brick/adaptor, HDMI cable, or game discs are visible in either photo.
No photo shows the console powered on, a dashboard, or any game disc with 'FC' visible.
Watermark text 'NWODIKA SOMTO' overlays both images; does not affect item assessment.

identity.kind: game console with one wireless controller

claims.claim: Xbox One with one pad for sale
claims.evidence: Console body and controller shape in photo 0 and photo 1 are consistent with Xbox One, but no logo or serial is legible to confirm exact model/region.
No discs, game cases, or digital library screen shown in either photo.
Seller states this but no power brick is shown at all, so the nature/severity of the issue cannot be seen.

risks.risk: Console may not power on at all due to the disclosed adaptor issue, and without the correct proprietary power brick it is unusable regardless of internal condition.
risks.proof: A clip of the console powered on and booting to the Xbox dashboard using its original adaptor.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / non-functional unit

risks.risk: No power adaptor is pictured, so it may be missing entirely, adding a replacement cost.
risks.proof: A photo of the power brick and cable included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if adaptor is missing and must be sourced separately

risks.risk: The 6 games (including FC) are not shown, so they may not be included or may be damaged/unplayable discs.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual game cases/discs laid out next to the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-controller only, no games included

risks.risk: Controller pairing/battery condition unverified; could be faulty or missing battery cover/batteries.
risks.proof: A clip of the controller syncing and operating with the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controller condition unknown, worst case non-functional

risks.risk: Hard drive health and storage capacity unknown; could have corrupted storage or very limited space.
risks.proof: A photo/screenshot of the dashboard storage settings screen.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the dashboard, showing what the 'adaptor issue' actually is
Photo of the power brick/cable included in the sale
Photo of the 6 game discs/cases, including the FC title, laid next to the console
Short clip of the controller pairing and functioning (sticks, buttons, triggers)
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an Xbox One console with one controller, but the seller-disclosed adaptor issue combined with no visible power brick, no proof of power-on, and no visible games means it must be priced at worst case as a non-functional unit with accessories unproven.
